background.value: Lumen Water is a regional water utility. Customers rarely think about water until a bill arrives.

value.attitudinal: People see water as worth looking after
value.behavioural: Cut household use by 5% in 12 months

audience.value: Households in the utility's region, adults 25 to 54.

insight.value: People care about water in the abstract but never connect it to the tap they use.

value: Lumen Water has served the region for 40 years

desired_response.value: Make a small change at home this month.

value: Show the Lumen Water logo on every execution
